Aircraft.name: Jet Race - Kicking Fish
Aircraft.Instructions:
Kicking Fish By: HuskyDynamics
AG1: Canopy AG2: Drop Tank AG8: Engine (Default On)
Notes: Raw speed and off-the-scales agility help you reel in the competition before casting them back out into the Kicking Fish's fiery wake. Don't get caught off guard though, because you're not off the hook yet - this slick fish is both fast and feisty.
